The Service

Exact site reality. Structured for decisions.

Most project teams make expensive decisions based on incomplete site information. Alturascope changes that. We arrive, we document everything — structure, services, equipment, conditions, access — and we deliver a structured package your whole team can use immediately.

Every visit produces the same deliverable architecture: a navigable digital twin, a narrated video walkthrough, a detailed conditions report, and a platform your team can return to at any point. Built around the decision you're trying to make, not a generic survey checklist.

Where the project demands survey-grade accuracy — heritage structures, complex M&E environments, or facilities where dimensional precision is non-negotiable — we capture using professional LiDAR and photogrammetry instruments that produce millimetre-accurate point cloud data. The Matterport twin is built on top of that foundation, not instead of it.

We operate across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom under a single-vendor model. One brief. One standard. Consistent deliverables regardless of location.

What You Receive

The same structure. Every site. Every time.

Consistent deliverables mean your team can compare sites, brief consultants, and make decisions without re-learning a new format on every project.

Navigable Digital Twin

A navigable, accessible model of the space built from our site capture. Your team can explore every room and every surface without returning to site.

Narrated Video Walkthrough

A structured tour of the space with spoken commentary on conditions, concerns, and context.

Conditions Report

Written assessment with findings prioritised into P1, P2, and P3 so your team knows what to act on first.

Equipment & Asset Schedule

Fixture counts, equipment make and model, services connections — formatted for your procurement or fitout team.

Labeled Photo Storyboard

Every area documented with consistent labeling, accessible through our ScopeWalk platform.

ScopeWalk Platform Access

All deliverables structured and accessible through our proprietary portal. Not a folder of files — a usable project record.

Coverage

One vendor. Any location.

Alturascope operates across all fifty US states and every Canadian province under a national travel model — travel costs are included in project pricing, not added as a surprise line item.

For projects in the United Kingdom, our dedicated UK operation covers England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

Whether you have one site or fifty, you brief us once and receive the same standard of work regardless of where the building is.

ScopeWalk™

Every deliverable. One place. Permanently accessible.

ScopeWalk is Alturascope's proprietary project portal. Not a file transfer link that expires — a structured, permanent record of every site we document. Your team can return to any project, any time, and find the same organised, labeled deliverables in the same place.

For multi-site and rollout programmes, ScopeWalk allows your team to compare properties side by side, track programme progress, and brief consultants directly from the portal without hunting through email chains for the right file.
